explanation: Mathlib has `ProfiniteGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.denseRange` for the canonical map into the full profinite completion, and `ProfiniteGrp.denseRange_toLimit` for a profinite group’s map into its limit of open-normal quotients. Neither states density of the abstract free product’s map into the limit over the restricted admissible quotients used here; relating those targets would require more than routine glue. I also searched Mathlib’s `denseRange` declarations and found no matching result.
